propositions: Pin drift, enforcement posture, and review-phase compatibility must be exposed in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit, close errors, web UI) without persisting warning events or adding noise to ordinary list output.

All detailed renderers must consume DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract and display canonical related tickets, normalized roles, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and phase metadata with consistent semantics.
Pin enforcement disabled state must be rendered as visibly advisory; legacy-unpinned relationships must be distinguishable from current-no-relationships.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at page assembly boundary with proper error handling: missing attestation, unexpected output, timeout, or exception must be logged and rendered as unavailable without changing audit_trail behavior.
Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must be updated for pins, phases, toggles, deleted targets, and close-versus-claim freshness; basic user docs remain unchanged.
